name: m1
idea_origin: Matteo requests synthesis of his v10 and the public action-note investigations of 27 October 2026.
hypothesis: A typed, source-aware checkpoint makes v10 priorities executable across decisions, avoids falsely inferring caps from one zero gain and avoids clearing incident history on calm feedback, without sacrificing promotion or survival.
change: Preserve honest relationship-aware choices, review preparation, weak-review recovery, financial and health protection, and blocker-directed growth. Replace categorical cap inference with observed-payoff hypotheses; separate serious incidents from warnings; add bounded factual checkpoints and progressive public-log recovery.
predicted_behaviour: Notes retain unresolved risks and commitments, formal review provenance and atomic realised payoffs. The actor reconciles the next choice with its note, redirects repeatedly ineffective investment, and considers Skill when strong Network and Output coexist with stalled promotion.
refutation: Reject execution claims if checkpoints omit material unresolved facts, exceed the channel limit, confuse promised with realised gains, or contradict choices. Reject performance claims if a future frozen matched comparison fails to improve promotion progression without reducing completion. No such comparison has been run.
notes: Unvalidated candidate only; no registration, games or model calls authorised by this creation task. Parent commit 04e136797f8b443a3bd026bd83bfa530c002f3e9. Length compliance is an instruction, not a runtime guarantee.
